visualCharacteristics: Split article header: full-bleed photographic image on one side, a solid content panel on the other holding a line-of-business eyebrow, article title (h1), publish date, author portrait + name, and a summary paragraph.
contentPattern: Row 1: image. Following rows: eyebrow + title + date + author + summary (rich text).
usage: Header for insights/article pages that pair a hero image with article metadata.
